project_name: VozLead - Agentes de Voz IA Hyper-Realistas para Cualificación de Leads en España

landing_page.nav: Glassmorphic floating header with backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/80 border border-slate-800/80, brand logo with pulsing live voice icon, links to Ventajas, Demostración, Precios, FAQ, and CTA buttons 'Iniciar Sesión' and 'Probar Gratis'
landing_page.hero: Asymmetric hero with high-impact headline ('Tus leads contactados en <30s por Voz IA 100% Real'), video/audio live demo widget with realistic background noise toggle (oficina, teclados, call center), interactive test call input (+34 phone number picker)
landing_page.features: Bento grid mode A showing 30s speed comparison, office ambient noise simulator, Spanish es-ES natural intonation, CRM integration sync, and lead scoring engine
landing_page.comparison: Side-by-side card comparison matrix: Agente Humano vs VozLead IA vs Chatbot Convencional
landing_page.cta_section: High-conversion sticky dark banner with immediate demo call trial

dashboard.navigation: Collapsible sidebar (240px -> 64px) with quick switcher, links for 'Agentes IA', 'Leads & Llamadas', 'Agenda & Citas', 'Lista Negra (Do Not Call)', 'Formulario Embebible', 'Configuración Telefonía'
dashboard.header: Top bar displaying Active Telephony Status ('Twilio / SIP Conectado' with green status indicator), Active Voice Credits balance, quick 'Crear Agente' CTA, and User Profile menu
dashboard.agents_builder: Multi-tab editor: 1) Configuración General (nombre, empresa, objetivo: Calificar y agendar / Solo calificar / Vender), 2) Selector de Voz es-ES (Mateo, Sofía, Javier, Carmen) con preview de audio, 3) Ruido de Fondo (Oficina Corporativa, Call Center, Teclados, Ninguno) + Deslizador de volumen (0-100%), 4) Preguntas de Cualificación, 5) Saludo Inicial Editable, 6) Pruebas ('Llamarme Ahora') y Código para Embeber
dashboard.leads_panel: Dense data table with search, status filters (llamando, sin respuesta, calificado, no interesado, cita agendada, venta, no llamar), detail view dialog with interactive Web Audio waveform player, dual transcript chat view (Lead vs Agente), AI summary bullet points, and Interest Score meter (0-100%)
dashboard.agenda: Weekly hour slot availability editor + interactive calendar viewer of upcoming qualified appointments
dashboard.do_not_call: Blocked phone numbers table with instant addition input, search, and CSV import simulation
dashboard.embeddable_form_page: Previewable public lead form with live phone validation (+34), consent checkbox, and copyable Iframe/Script snippet

audio_ambience_simulation.tech: Web Audio API synth + HTML5 Audio / oscillator noise simulation for background office ambience (keyboard typing clicks, low murmurs, paper shuffling) with real-time gain/volume slider

testing_and_data_testids.rule: Every interactive and critical informational element MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all user-visible strings are in Spanish (Spain es-ES).
Implement real audio preview simulations using standard Web Audio API synthesis or pre-generated sound effects for realistic keyboard/office ambience.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds in dropdowns, header, or modals. Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-950/90 border border-slate-800.
Ensure high contrast compliance: minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large headings.
Add explicit hover states with text color preservation (e.g. hover:bg-emerald-600 hover:text-white).
Include sample initial leads data with realistic Spanish names (e.g., Carlos Ruiz, María Fernández, Alejandro Gómez) and valid Spanish mobile formats (+34 6xx xxx xxx).
